q: Store your own name, your city and your age in three variables, then print them in one sentence.
code:
name = "Anita"
city = "Chennai"
age  = 22
print(name, "is", age, "and lives in", city)
out: Anita is 22 and lives in Chennai

q: Print the type of each of these: 7, 7.0, "7", True. Say out loud why 7 and "7" are different.
code:
for v in [7, 7.0, "7", True]:
    print(v, "->", type(v))
